description_en: Elite villa with swimming pool for sale in a super Complex in Farke! In the Farka Lake area, an area with high development potential in Tirana where a new residential project is coming to life, we offer for sale a villa with a swimming pool! The villa has an individual plot area of ​​1'004m2, a living area of ​​315.3 m2 and a basement area of ​​54 m2. The villa is organized on two floors, the entrance stairs to the living areas, a technical area and two parking spaces. On the ground floor there is a living room with a separate kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. On the first floor of the villa there is also a spacious living area and separate kitchen area, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The villa has a swimming pool, a well and green areas around it. The complex promises privacy, elite coexistence, modern architecture, quality & security. There you will find entertainment, entertainment, culture and a variety of sports activities. The advantages of this project are many, among them we can mention: ▪️Strategic positioning; ▪️ Individuality; ▪️Elite Coexistence; ▪️Privacy; ▪️Quality & safety; ▪️ Embracing nature; ▪️In the suburbs but very close to the capital; ▪️Services & Facilities, in an area that promises development; ▪️Management & administration of common spaces; ▪️Multifunctional project Living in this Complex means enjoying a quiet and private lifestyle in harmony with nature, while also enjoying the comforts of urban living.
